nexus-tweaks.config.general.comment.open:
The hotkey that opens this config screen.
The default is N + T (hold N and press T).
nexus-tweaks.config.tweaks.comment.autoR:
When enabled, sneaking and pressing the Use Item key while looking at nothing repairs the tool in your selected hotbar slot using your experience.
The rate matches vanilla Mending: 1 experience point restores 2 durability.
On a multiplayer server this needs the Nexus-Sync mod on the server side.

Item IDs that Auto Repair must never trigger on.
Items with a use animation (bows, shields, food and so on) and items you can equip with a right click (armor, elytra and so on) are skipped automatically, so this list is only needed for items that act on an empty right click without any animation - the fishing rod being the main one.
nexus-tweaks.config.tweaks.comment.massC:
When enabled, Item Scroller's massCraft is carried out by the server (Nexus-Sync) instead of by rapid clicking.
The client only sends one request, and the server fills the crafting grid, crafts, and throws out the results.
This needs Item Scroller on the client and Nexus-Sync on the server. Without either of them, Item Scroller crafts as usual.

Off by default. With it off, Item Scroller still uses its own recipe book method. Turn it on when your connection is poor, or when you mass craft recipes that are not in the recipe book.
